name: Konspec UI
purpose: Copy-paste HTML components for internal data applications. Light theme only.
moved: This file no longer contains the registry. It was 7.8 MB — about 2,275,959 tokens, or 11x a 200k context window — so every agent that fetched it received a silently truncated file. The same data is at the endpoints below, in pieces sized to be read.

endpoints.read_first: /llms.txt — the rules, the tokens and every component with its variant ids. Short, and written to be read whole.
endpoints.index: /r/index.json — the spec, and every component summarised with its variant ids. No markup, no per-component prose.
endpoints.note: Fetch the smallest thing that answers the question. llms.txt already lists every component with its variant ids, so an agent that read it can build a variant URL directly and never needs the index.
endpoints.component: /r/<id>.json — one component: rules, anatomy, behaviour, accessibility, and the id and name of every variant. No html.
endpoints.variant: /r/<id>/<variant>.html — the markup, raw, ready to paste
endpoints.component_full: /r/<id>.full.json — the pre-split shape, component prose and every variant's html in one file. Back-compat; prefer the two above.
